name: Noah
source:
"I'll die surrounded by my blank canvases, and then finally I'll have my only masterpiece."

Noah is the lonesome painter protagonist of Dreambound. Blessed, or perhaps cursed, with the ability to enter dreams, he instead shuts himself up ih his home in search of his masterpiece.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/gabmag/dreambound]Kickstarter[/url]]
